targetedMiss: The targeted attack missed its mark!
partSeverelyDamaged: {part} severely damaged, but the monster is still too strong!

log.missed: {actor} aims for {enemy}'s {part} and finds nothing but air.

limbs.helpMineNone: {part} is no use for taking a hold.

note.vital: a vital part, and it fights to stay out of your hands.
note.awkward: small and awkward, and hard to keep a grip on.
note.plain: solid enough to get both hands around.

strike.name: Strike
strike.miss: {actor} swings at {enemy}'s {part} and finds only air.

lock.name: Joint Lock
lock.hit: {actor} folds {enemy}'s {part} the wrong way and pins it down!
lock.miss: {enemy} slips the lock before {actor} can set it.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.miss: {actor} hauls at {enemy}'s {part}, but it will not turn.

slam.name: Slam
slam.hit: {actor} lifts {enemy} and drives it down on its {part}!
slam.miss: {actor} tries to lift {enemy} and cannot get under it.

choke.name: Choke
choke.hit: {actor} closes on {enemy}'s {part} and squeezes the air out of it!
choke.miss: {enemy} tucks its {part} away before the choke closes.

rip.name: Tear Off
rip.hit: {actor} braces against {enemy} and hauls at its {part}!
rip.miss: {actor} cannot get a grip worth pulling on.

shove.name: Shove Back
shove.hit: {actor} drives {enemy} back a square by its {part}!
shove.miss: {actor} shoves at {enemy} and it does not budge.

throw.name: Throw
throw.hit: {actor} swings {enemy} by its {part} and hurls it away!
throw.miss: {actor} tries to swing {enemy} around and loses the grip.

suplex.name: Suplex
suplex.hit: {actor} lifts {enemy} over and plants its {part} in the ground behind!
suplex.miss: {actor} tries to take {enemy} over backwards and buckles.

log.reversal: {enemy} turns the hold around and wrings {actor}'s {part}!
log.noLimb: {actor} has nothing left to wrestle with.
log.finisherHit: {actor} sets up and lands {skill} on the {part}!
log.finisherMiss: {actor} goes for {skill}, but {enemy} is not where it should be.
